end.summary: Practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples such as earthworms, ants, beetles, millipedes, woodlice, and termites. Pihu shared examples from seeing an earthworm and ants, but mixed up earthworms with insects; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, look at a picture of an earthworm and an ant together and discuss one difference. The session ended when Pihu said they were tired.
